newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady to firm in thin talks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady to firm in thin talks.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted steady to slightly higher on Monday with players staying on the sidelines looking for new directions, traders said.

"There's hardly any trading interest today," said one trader. Some sellers raised prices slightly higher amid crude rebounds but some shipowners were still waiting for price falls on weak fuel oil swaps. March swaps was indicated at $96/$98 per tonne against Friday's $97/$98 for the 180-cst grade.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $96-$98 per tonne and 180-cst at $102-$104. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $190-$192 and $203-$206 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
